title: Review actor context ranking decoder and training harness (untrained)
body:
Combines the trained F15 actor context with the retained filtered actor ranking hinge, preserving all 42 donor tensors and freezing the 36 nonactor tensors. The fixed candidate trains six actor/query/gate tensors with fresh Adam for one 32-update attempt.

The source and training/evaluation harness are independently reviewed. The current module rejects Boolean/decimal training-index aliases, and all recorded ranking domains must join the exact training text and gold spans. Validation includes 11 original model controls plus 19 independent controls, an actual import-only bootstrap with 17 measured loaded modules, and 55 independently replayed evaluator controls. Both frozen N11 and F15 comparisons cover all nine scored groups in raw and joint views. These are source/fixture checks, not a model accuracy result.

Training is pending a reviewed runtime migration. The old adapter rejects the existing scheduler's newer 24-field configuration. Qualified diagnostics established the current configuration without changing it. The new bridge must retain current PID safeguards and lease-draining behavior; this experiment's own request remains two CPUs, 1536 MiB and one child. Current storage capacity and admission remain unqualified.

The complete draft tree preserves all 31,843 incoming main entries and adds 105 paths for the candidate, tests, report and public evidence. An independent stage audit verified the exact tree and public-only packet boundary. Prior failed checks and superseded drafts remain evidence.

No F16 training, accuracy gain, new weight release, main merge or default promotion is claimed. Latest trained F15 remains 154/168 complete training IR matches in both views. Active 8D/384D/768D latent semantics, independent statutory gold and `lake build legal` remain unqualified. No hosted CI pass is claimed.

See [the report](docs/autoencoders/actor_context_ranking_20261014.md) and [public evidence](docs/implementation/reports/evidence/legal-actor-context-ranking-20261014-01).
